name: manganese chloride
uses: INDICATIONS AND USAGE Manganese 0.1 mg/mL (Manganese Chloride Injection, USP) is indicated for use in adult patients as a supplement to intravenous solutions given for TPN. Administration helps to maintain manganese serum levels and to prevent depletion of endogenous stores and subsequent deficiency symptoms.
pediatric: Pediatric Use (See DOSAGE AND ADMINISTRATION section.) Safety and effectiveness in pediatric patients have not been established.
